name: Idiopathic Restrictive Cardiomyopathy

criteria.description: Evidence of diastolic dysfunction with restrictive filling pattern on echocardiography or cardiac catheterization
Preserved or normal left ventricular systolic function
Exclusion of secondary causes such as infiltrative, storage, or systemic diseases
Endomyocardial biopsy showing nonspecific fibrosis without infiltrative or inflammatory disease

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of diastolic dysfunction with restrictive filling pattern and normal systolic function, plus exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires comprehensive evaluation to exclude other etiologies of restrictive cardiomyopathy.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Exercise intolerance due to diastolic dysfunction
searchTerms: exercise intolerance from heart filling problems
shortness of breath with activity due to diastolic dysfunction
poor exercise capacity from heart relaxation issues

pathognomonic.symptomName: Kussmaul's sign (paradoxical jugular venous distension on inspiration)
searchTerms: neck vein swelling that worsens on breathing in
jugular vein distension increasing with inspiration
paradoxical neck vein bulging on inhaling

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated natriuretic peptides (BNP or NT-proBNP)
imaging: Echocardiogram showing restrictive filling pattern with normal ejection fraction
Biatrial enlargement on echocardiography or MRI
Cardiac MRI may show myocardial fibrosis without infiltration
genetic: No known specific genetic mutations identified; idiopathic etiology
other: Endomyocardial biopsy showing nonspecific fibrosis without infiltrative or inflammatory pathology

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of amyloid deposits on biopsy
Patchy myocardial uptake on PET scan
Systolic anterior motion of mitral valve

redFlags: Rapid progression of heart failure symptoms
references: Maron BJ, Towbin JA, Thiene G, et al. Contemporary definitions and classification of the cardiomyopathies: an American Heart Association Scientific Statement. Circulation. 2006;113(14):1807-1816.

Elliott P, Andersson B, Arbustini E, et al. Classification of the cardiomyopathies: a position statement from the European Society Of Cardiology Working Group on Myocardial and Pericardial Diseases. Eur Heart J. 2008;29(2):270-276.
Kushwaha SS, Fallon JT, Fuster V. Restrictive cardiomyopathy. N Engl J Med. 1997;336(4):267-276.
